simple.summary: מָסָה (mâçâh) means to dissolve First listed occurrence: Josh 14 8.

definitions.usage: make to consume away, (make to) melt, water.
definitions.full: H4529. masah [ מָסָה ] verb melt, dissolve, be liquefied (Ethiopic liquefy ; Aramaic מְסָא melt away , dissolve, decay, coagulate ; Assyrian masû is wash ; see also מסס ); — only Hiph`il Perfect 3plural הִמְסִיו Josh 14:8 (on form see Ges § 75 R.17). Imperfect sf . יַּעמסֵם Psa 147:18 ; 2 masculine singular וַתֶּ֫מֶס 39:12 ; אַמְסֶה 6:7 ; — cause to dissolve, melt , ice 147:18 ; hyperb. אַמְּסֶה עַרְשִׁי בְּדִמְעָתִי 6:7 with my tears I cause my bed to dissolve ; חֲמוּדוֺ כָּעָשׁ וַתֶּמֶס 39:12 = consume, cause to vanish ; figurative followed by לֵב = intimidate Josh 14:8 . I. [ מַסָּה ] see מסס . II, III. מַסָּה see נסה . [ מִסָּה ] see מִסַּת . מַסְוֶה see סוה מְסוּכָה = מְשׂוּכָה see II. סוך ( שׂוך ).
